note.zh: 三个已标记的星系可任意顺序勘测；前两个只清除标记，只有第三个会生成风信子号所在的星系。另有一版无船的同一勘测。
note.en: The three charted systems can be surveyed in any order; only the third reveals the Hyacinth’s system. A ship-less version of the same survey also exists.

notes.zh: 随时间随机发生（平均1个月，注释写着80），需人类玩家、human_2旗标、非“破碎枷锁”起源，且附近有三个未勘测的无主星系（country_events_1.txt:3785-3843）。
notes.en: Random over time (mean 1 month, commented as 80), needs a human player, the human_2 flag, not the Broken Shackles origin and three unsurveyed unowned systems nearby (country_events_1.txt:3785-3843).

notes.zh: 前四个选项只是对话（is_dialog_only），第五个选项继续到 country.257。
notes.en: The first four options are dialogue only (is_dialog_only); the fifth continues to country.257.
